$comment: How many tokens a formation packet's driver bytes take, for S4's capacity bound (stage_form.form_budget; W review of WP-09 r1, F5, lead decision). The fewest bytes per token measured is taken, so a packet's tokens are counted high, never low.
basis: C1 (2026-11-03): driver bytes over host-reported input tokens across its six live S3 calls (claude-sonnet-5-5/high), 1.94 to 2.19 bytes a token; C2-pre's S4 estimates rest on the same range. Measured on S3 packets of the sonnet seat, not on a formation packet of the opus seat: the first live S4 call's driver bytes and reported input tokens give its own.
